title: Rainbow Six Siege Director Braces for GTA 6 Launch Impact
description: Ubisoft discusses bracing for the massive industry impact of GTA 6, promising to treat remaining Rainbow Six Siege players like royalty.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Industry-Wide Ripple Effects of the GTA 6 Launch

As the gaming world eagerly awaits the upcoming release of Grand Theft Auto 6, developers and publishers across the industry are openly discussing how to prepare for the seismic shift the game will inevitably bring to the market. When a titan of this scale enters the ecosystem, live-service and multiplayer games alike brace themselves for potential shifts in active player counts and community attention.

According to reports from IGN Games, Ubisoft has addressed how it is bracing for the launch of GTA 6. For established tactical shooters and online multiplayer titles, the arrival of Rockstar's blockbuster represents a unique moment in gaming history where audience bandwidth will undoubtedly be heavily tested.

## Rewarding Loyalty: Treating Players Like Royalty

Rather than ignoring the inevitable disruption, the team behind Rainbow Six Siege is proactively planning for the period surrounding the GTA 6 launch. The game's director has made it clear that while they anticipate taking a hit in terms of player engagement, they are preparing to reward the dedicated community members who choose to stick around.

In a clear message to the player base, Ubisoft promised that those who remain active in Rainbow Six Siege through the launch window will be served "like kings and queens." While specific in-game events, rewards, or updates tied to this initiative have yet to be fully detailed, the commitment highlights a growing industry trend: doubling down on core, loyal communities when major market disruptors arrive.

## Editor's Take
It is refreshing to see a major publisher openly acknowledge the gravitational pull of GTA 6 rather than pretending it won't affect them. By shifting focus toward rewarding their most dedicated players, Ubisoft's approach with Rainbow Six Siege offers a smart masterclass in how live-service games can weather the biggest industry storms.
